premise: Rain comes and the small ones squeeze under the big leaf — Glider, Dragonfly — drip, drop off its edge; they worry about Fern out in the rain, but Fern can't walk and doesn't want to: he lifts every frond and drinks it in. Then a rainbow.
inspiration: The Mitten (Ukrainian folk tale: the animals squeezing into one mitten), turned: the one left outside is the happiest of all.
lesson: What's right for one friend isn't right for every friend.

en-US.title: Room Under the Leaf
en-US.text: {leaf:enter} {fern:enter} [curious] Plip. Plop. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Pitter-patter… here came the rain! {glider:enter} {glider:go under leaf} Glider scampered under the big leaf. {glider:face happy} "It's dry under here! Come in!" {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:go under leaf} Dragonfly zipped in beside him. Squeeze, squeeze. {leaf:live drip} {sfx:drip} Drip… drop… went the edges of the leaf. {glider:live shiver} Glider gave a little shiver: one drop had landed on his whiskers. [giggles] Then they peeked out… {glider:face surprised} {dragonfly:face surprised} and there was Fern, out in the rain, all on his own! [nervously] "Fern! Come under here!" called Dragonfly. "You'll get soaked!" But Fern couldn't walk. And he didn't want to. {fern:face happy} {fern:live perk-up hold} He lifted every frond up high, as wide as they would go. [happily] "Soaked? I LOVE the rain!" {glider:face happy} {dragonfly:face happy} [laughs] So Glider and Dragonfly stayed snug under the leaf, and Fern drank up the rain, until… {canvas:rain stop} it stopped. {canvas:rainbow} A rainbow curved over the valley. {glider:hop} {dragonfly:hop} And there was Fern, the shiniest, greenest fern of all.

es-ES.title: Sitio bajo la hoja
es-ES.text: {leaf:enter} {fern:enter} [curious] Plic. Ploc. {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} Plic, ploc, plic… ¡venía la lluvia! {glider:enter} {glider:go under leaf} Planeador corrió a meterse debajo de la hoja grande. {glider:face happy} —¡Aquí no se moja nadie! ¡Venid! {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:go under leaf} Libélula entró zumbando a su lado. Apretaditos, apretaditos. {leaf:live drip} {sfx:drip} Gota… gota… caía del borde de la hoja. {glider:live shiver} Planeador tiritó un poquito: una gota le había caído en los bigotes. [giggles] Entonces se asomaron… {glider:face surprised} {dragonfly:face surprised} ¡y allí estaba Helecho, solito bajo la lluvia! [nervously] —¡Helecho! ¡Ven aquí debajo! —gritó Libélula—. ¡Te vas a empapar! Pero Helecho no podía andar. Y tampoco quería. {fern:face happy} {fern:live perk-up hold} Levantó todas sus hojas, bien altas, bien abiertas. [happily] —¿Empaparme? ¡Me ENCANTA la lluvia! {glider:face happy} {dragonfly:face happy} [laughs] Así que Planeador y Libélula se quedaron calentitos bajo la hoja, y Helecho se bebió toda la lluvia, hasta que… {canvas:rain stop} paró. {canvas:rainbow} Un arcoíris se dibujó sobre el valle. {glider:hop} {dragonfly:hop} Y allí estaba Helecho, el más verde y el más brillante de todos.
